name.value: Ricardo's Ice Cream, Coffee, Bubble Tea

description.value: Ricardo's is a cafe on White Rock's Marine Drive serving ice cream, coffee, and bubble tea. Marine Drive runs along the waterfront promenade, making this a natural stop for cyclists riding the popular White Rock beachfront route. The multi-item menu covers both refreshment and pick-me-up options in a single stop.
